properties.summary: The Karacaahmet Cemetery is a 700-year-old historic cemetery located in Üsküdar, on the Asian side of Istanbul. Karacaahmet cemetery is the largest and second oldest in Istanbul at 750 acres, and the largest burial ground in Turkey by number of interred.

properties.summary: The Istanbul Naval Museum is a national naval museum, located in the Beşiktaş district of Istanbul, Turkey. It was established in 1897 by the Ottoman Minister of the Navy Bozcaadalı Hasan Hüsnü Pasha.

properties.summary: Hagia Triada is a Greek Orthodox church in Istanbul, Turkey. The building was erected in 1880 and is considered the largest Greek Orthodox shrine in Istanbul today. It is still in use by the Greek community of Istanbul. It has about 150 parishioners.

properties.name: Sakıp Sabancı Museum
properties.summary: The Sabancı University Sakıp Sabancı Museum is a private fine arts museum in Istanbul, Turkey, dedicated to calligraphic art, religious and state documents, as well as paintings of the Ottoman era. The museum was founded by Sakıp Sabancı, and was opened in June 2002.

properties.name: Zal Mahmud Pasha Mosque
properties.summary: The Zal Mahmud Pasha Mosque is a 16th-century Ottoman mosque located in the Eyüp district of Istanbul, Turkey. It was designed by the imperial architect Mimar Sinan and completed in 1590.

properties.name: Column of the Goths
properties.blurb: Roman triumphal column in Constantinople (Istanbul, Turkey)
properties.summary: The Column of the Goths is a Roman victory column dating to the third or fourth century A.D. It stands in what is now Gülhane Park, Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Atik Mustafa Pasha Mosque
properties.summary: Atik Mustafa Pasha Mosque is a former Eastern Orthodox church in Istanbul, converted into a mosque by the Ottomans.

properties.name: Yıldız Park
properties.summary: Yıldız Park is a historical, urban park in the Beşiktaş district of Istanbul, Turkey. It is one of the largest public parks in Istanbul. The park is located in Yıldız quarter between the palaces of Yıldız and Çırağan.

properties.name: Hirami Ahmed Pasha Mosque
properties.summary: Hirami Ahmet Pasha Mosque is a former Eastern Orthodox church converted into a mosque by the Ottomans. The small church, one among the 36 dedicated to Saint John the Baptist in Constantinople, was part of a monastery bearing the same name.

properties.summary: Tarabya is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is located on the European shoreline of the Bosphorus strait, between the neighbourhoods of Yeniköy and Kireçburnu. It is famous for its coastal fish restaurants.

properties.name: Sinan Pasha Mosque

photos.file: Sinan Pasha Mosque, dome and minaret.jpg
photos.author: Mustafa-trit20

properties.summary: The Sinan Pasha Mosque is an Ottoman mosque located in a densely populated district of Beşiktaş, in Istanbul, Turkey. It was built by the Ottoman architect Mimar Sinan for the admiral Sinan Pasha. The türbe of Barbaros Hayrettin Pasha is located just across the street.

photos.author: Esme Vos from San Francisco and Amsterdam, Netherlands

properties.summary: Cihangir is an affluent neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beyoğlu, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is located between Taksim Square and Kabataş. It has many narrow streets, two parks, and many street cafes especially in and around Akarsu Yokuşu Sokağı.

properties.name: Column of Marcian
properties.blurb: Roman triumphal column in Constantinople (Istanbul, Turkey)
properties.summary: The Column of Marcian is a Roman honorific column erected in Constantinople by the praefectus urbi Tatianus and dedicated to the Emperor Marcian. It is located in the present-day Fatih district of Istanbul.

properties.name: Molla Gürani Mosque
properties.summary: Church-Mosque of Vefa is a former Eastern Orthodox church converted into a mosque by the Ottomans in Istanbul. The church was possibly dedicated to Hagios Theodoros, but this dedication is far from certain.

properties.name: Beylerbeyi
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Üsküdar, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Beylerbeyi is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Üsküdar, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is located on the Asian shore of the Bosporus, to the north of the Bosphorus Bridge.

properties.name: Mese
properties.summary: The Mese was the main thoroughfare of ancient Constantinople and the scene of many Byzantine imperial processions. Its ancient course is largely followed by the modern Divan Yolu.

properties.summary: The Fountain of Sultan Ahmed III is a fountain in the great square in front of the Imperial Gate of Topkapı Palace in Istanbul, Turkey. It was built under Ottoman sultan Ahmed III in 1728, in the style of the Tulip period.

properties.summary: The Şemsi Pasha Mosque is an Ottoman mosque located in the large and densely populated district of Üsküdar, in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.summary: Yeniköy, known in Greek as Neochorion, Neochori, or Nichori, sometimes also referred to as Yeni Kioi, is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is located on the European shores of the Bosphorus strait, between the neighbourhoods of İstinye and Tarabya.

properties.name: Çengelköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Üsküdar, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Çengelköy is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Üsküdar, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the Asian shore of the Bosphorus strait, between the neighborhoods of Beylerbeyi and Kuleli. It is mainly a residential district. Many mansions were built there in the Ottoman period.

properties.name: Harbour of Eleutherios
properties.blurb: One of the harbours of Constantinople, built by Theodosius on the Sea of Marmara
properties.summary: The Harbour of Theodosius was one of the ports of ancient Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire, located beneath the modern Yenikapi neighbourhood of Istanbul, Turkey. It was built at the mouth of the Lycus watercourse that ran through the city to the Propontis.

properties.name: Yedikule
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Fatih, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Yedikule is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Fatih, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is named after the seven-towered Yedikule Fortress, which surrounds the neighborhood. Urbanized in the 16th century, the neighborhood became a hub for industrial and agricultural activities.

properties.name: Dolmabahçe Clock Tower
properties.summary: Dolmabahçe Clock Tower is a clock tower situated outside Dolmabahçe Palace in Istanbul, Turkey. Its construction was ordered by Ottoman sultan Abdülhamid II and designed by the court architect Sarkis Balyan between 1890 and 1895.

properties.name: Ashkenazi Synagogue of Istanbul

photos.file: Dome of the Istanbul Ashkenazi Sinagogue.JPG
photos.author: Alaexis

properties.summary: The Ashkenazi Synagogue is an Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located near the Galata Tower in Karaköy neighborhood of Beyoğlu in Istanbul, Turkey. The congregation worships in the Ashkenazi rite. It is the only currently active Ashkenazi synagogue in Istanbul open to visits and prayers.

properties.summary: Süreyya Opera House, also called Süreyya Cultural Center, is an opera hall located at Gen. Asım Gündüz Avenue No: 29, in the Bahariye quarter of the Kadıköy district in Istanbul, Turkey.

photos.author: Francesco Bini

properties.summary: The Atik Valide Mosque, meaning Old Mother Mosque, is a 16th century Ottoman imperial mosque located on a hill above the large and densely populated district of Üsküdar, in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.summary: The Church of St. Polyeuctus was an ancient Byzantine church in Constantinople built by the noblewoman Anicia Juliana and dedicated to Saint Polyeuctus.

photos.author: The original uploader was Cjs2111 at English Wikipedia.

properties.summary: The Teşvikiye Mosque is a neo-baroque structure located in the Teşvikiye neighbourhood of Şişli district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Church of Saint Benoit, Istanbul
properties.summary: Saint Benoit is a Roman Catholic Church in Istanbul, Turkey, important for historical reasons. Established in 1427, the shrine is the oldest Catholic church of Istanbul still in use.

properties.name: Mecidiyeköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Şişli, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey

photos.author: VikiPicture

properties.summary: Mecidiyeköy is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Şişli, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is a heavily built-up residential and business neighbourhood, squeezed in between the Fulya, Kuştepe, Gültepe, Esentepe, and Gülbahar neighbourhoods.

properties.name: Eyüpsultan Cemetery

photos.author: G.dallorto

properties.summary: The Eyüp Cemetery, aka Eyüp Sultan Cemetery, is a historic burial ground located in the Eyüp district, on the European side of Istanbul, Turkey. It is administered by the General Directorate of Foundations.

properties.name: Emirgan Park
properties.blurb: historical urban park in the Sarıyer district of Istanbul, Turkey
properties.summary: Emirgan Park is a historical urban park located in the Emirgan neighbourhood in the Sarıyer district of Istanbul, Turkey, on the European coast of the Bosphorus. It is one of the largest public parks in Istanbul.

properties.name: Büyük Çamlıca Hill
properties.blurb: one of the seven hills of Istanbul
properties.summary: Çamlıca Hill, a.k.a. Big Çamlıca Hill to differentiate it from the nearby Little Çamlıca Hill, is a hill in the Üsküdar district of the Asian side of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Istanbul Military Museum

photos.author: Dosseman

properties.summary: The Istanbul Military Museum is a museum of military history located in Şişli, Istanbul. The museum is focused on Turkic history, and exhibits a large collection of Turkish military equipment from the 13th century to the modern day.

properties.name: Etiler
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beşiktaş, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Etiler is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beşiktaş, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the European side of Istanbul, close to the business quarters of Levent and Maslak.

properties.name: Jewish Museum of Turkey
properties.blurb: museum in Beyoğlu, İstanbul, European Turkey

photos.file: Zulfaris synagogue jewish museum turkey ehal.jpg
photos.author: Yusuf Pinhas

properties.summary: The Jewish Museum of Turkey is a Jewish museum and cultural center established by the Quincentennial Foundation to inform the society of the traditions and history of Turkish Jewry. It was inaugurated on November 25, 2001.

properties.name: Yenikapı
properties.summary: Yenikapı is a port and a quarter in Istanbul, Turkey, in the metropolitan district of Fatih on the European side of the Bosphorus, and along the southern shore of the city's historically central peninsula.

properties.name: Şişli Mosque

photos.author: The original uploader was Mirada at Turkish Wikipedia.

properties.summary: The Şişli Mosque is a mosque located in Şişli Square between the Büyükdere Avenue, the Halaskargazi and Abide-i Hürriyet streets in the Şişli district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.summary: The Port of Haydarpaşa, also known as the Port of Haidar Pasha or the Port of Istanbul, is a general cargo seaport, ro-ro and container terminal, situated in Haydarpaşa, Istanbul, Turkey at the southern entrance to the Bosphorus, near Haydarpaşa Station.

properties.name: Gazi Atik Ali Pasha Mosque

photos.file: Vezir Han view of Atik Ali Pasha Mosque 6207.jpg
photos.author: Dosseman

properties.summary: The Gazi Atik Ali Pasha Mosque is a 15th-century Ottoman mosque located in the Çemberlitaş neighbourhood of the Fatih district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Ihlamur Palace
properties.blurb: former imperial Ottoman summer palace located in Istanbul, Turkey
properties.summary: Ihlamur Palace, is a former imperial Ottoman summer pavilion located in Istanbul, Turkey. It was constructed during the reign of Sultan Abdülmecid I. properties.name: Aşiyan Asri Cemetery
properties.summary: The Aşiyan Asri Cemetery is a burial ground situated on Aşiyan between the Bebek and Rumelihisarı neighborhoods of the European part of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Palace of Lausus
properties.summary: The Palace of Lausus or Lausos, also known as the Lauseion, was a 5th-century building located in Constantinople that was acquired and owned by the eunuch Lausus.

properties.name: Samatya
properties.summary: Samatya is a quarter of the Fatih district of Istanbul. It is located along the Marmara Sea, and borders to the west on the neighborhood of Yedikule.

properties.name: Zeynep Sultan Mosque
properties.summary: The Zeynep Sultan Mosque is a mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. It was built in 1769 by Ayazma Mosque's architect Mehmet Tahir Ağa for Ahmed III's daughter Zeynep Sultan. It evokes Byzantine churches because of its architectural style and materials that were used in its construction.

properties.name: Caddebostan
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Caddebostan is a neighborhood in the Kadıköy district, on the Asian side of Istanbul, Turkey. Caddebostan is bordered by the neighborhoods of Fenerbahçe in the west, Göztepe and Erenköy in the north, and Suadiye in the east.

properties.name: Sancaktar Hayrettin Mosque
properties.summary: Sancaktar Hayrettin Mosque is part of a former Eastern Orthodox monastery converted into a mosque by the Ottomans. It is generally believed that the small building belonged to the Byzantine Monastery of Gastria.

properties.name: Church of St. Mary Draperis

photos.author: Medelam

properties.summary: Saint Mary Draperis is a Catholic church in Istanbul, important for historical reasons. Established in 1678, the church is one of the most ancient Catholic parishes of Istanbul.

properties.name: Kanlıca
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beykoz, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey

photos.file: Elbiseci Ahmet Bey Yalısı and Esre Umur Yalısı in Kanlıca on the Bosphorus, Turkey 001.jpg
photos.author: Moonik

properties.summary: Kanlıca is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beykoz, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the Asian side of the Bosphorus strait. It is known for a yogurt sprinkled with caster sugar, which is sold in local cafés.

properties.name: Holy Mother of God cathedral
properties.blurb: Cathedral of Armenian Patriarchate of Constantinople
properties.summary: Surp Asdvadzadzin Patriarchal Church, also known as the Holy Mother of God Patriarchal Church, is an Armenian Apostolic church located in Kumkapı quarter of Fatih district in old Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Hasköy
properties.summary: Hasköy is a trading and residential district on the northern bank of the Golden Horn in Beyoğlu, Istanbul, Turkey. It includes the neighbourhoods of Keçeci Piri, Piri Paşa, and Halıcıoğlu, and parts of Camiikebir and Sütlüce. Immediately to the south lies Kasımpaşa.

properties.name: Esma Sultan Mansion

photos.file: Esma Sultan Yalısı içinden Boğaz Köprüsü.jpg
photos.author: Khutuck

properties.summary: The Esma Sultan Mansion, a historical yalı located on the Bosphorus in the Ortaköy neighborhood of Istanbul, Turkey and named after its original owner Princess Esma Sultan, is used today as a cultural center after being redeveloped.

properties.name: Anadolu Kavağı
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beykoz, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Anadolukavağı is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beykoz, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is at the northern end of the Bosphorus. "Anadolu" is the Turkish name for Anatolia, and "kavak" meant "control post" in Ottoman Turkish, suggesting the strategic importance of its location.

properties.name: Büyükdere
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey

photos.author: VikiPicture

properties.summary: Büyükdere is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is situated on the European shore of the Bosphorus strait about 2 km southwest of Sarıyer.

properties.name: Khedive Palace
properties.summary: The Khedive's Palace, also known as Çubuklu Palace, is located on the Asian side of the Bosphorus in Istanbul, Turkey, and was once the residence of Khedive Abbas II of Egypt and Sudan. In English it is also known as the Khedive's Pavilion or the Khedive's Mansion.

properties.name: Saint Gregory the Illuminator Church of Galata

photos.file: Surp Krikor Lusavoriç Ermeni Ortodoks Kilisesi.jpg
photos.author: Vikipolimer

properties.summary: The Saint Gregory the Illuminator Church of Galata is the oldest extant Armenian Apostolic church in Istanbul. It was originally built in the late 14th century, in the Genoan period, shortly before the fall of Constantinople to the Ottomans.

properties.name: santralistanbul

photos.file: Istanbul Bilgi University Santralistanbul Campus in March 2023.jpg
photos.author: Kurmanbek

properties.summary: The santralistanbul, opened in 2007, is an arts and cultural complex located at the upper end of Golden Horn where two small rivers, Alibeyköy and Kağıthane meet in the Eyüp district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Firuz Ağa Mosque
properties.summary: The Firuz Ağa Mosque is a 15th-century Ottoman mosque in the Fatih district of Istanbul, Turkey. It was built by Firuz Ağa, the head treasurer of Sultan Beyazıt II. The marble sarcophagus of Firuz Ağa is located in the mosque complex.

properties.name: Haydarpaşa
properties.summary: Haydarpaşa is a locality within the Kadıköy and Üsküdar districts on the Asian part of Istanbul, Turkey. Haydarpaşa is named after Ottoman Vizier Haydar Pasha. The place, on the coast of Bosporus, borders Harem in the northwest and Kadıköy in the southeast.

properties.name: Forum of the Ox
properties.summary: The Forum of the Ox was a public square in the city of Constantinople. Used also as a place for public executions and torture, it disappeared completely after the end of the Byzantine Empire.

properties.name: Laleli
properties.summary: Laleli is a neighbourhood of Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey, lying between Beyazıt and Aksaray. It is known for its large textile wholesaling business and is home to the Literature and Science Faculties of Istanbul University, designed by Sedad Hakkı Eldem and Emin Onat in the 1940s.

properties.name: Kurtuluş
properties.summary: Kurtuluş is a neighbourhood of the Şişli district of Istanbul that was originally called Tatavla, meaning 'stables' in Greek. The modern Turkish name means "liberation", "salvation", "independence" or "deliverance".

properties.name: Haliç Bridge

photos.author: G.dallorto
J Brew from near Seattle, USA

properties.summary: The Haliç Bridge, or the Golden Horn Bridge, is a road bridge across the Golden Horn in Istanbul, Turkey. It connects the neighbourhoods of Ayvansaray in the southwest and Halıcıoğlu in the northwest. The bridge carries the O-1 motorway, also known as the Istanbul Inner Beltway.

properties.summary: SS Peter and Paul is a Catholic church in Istanbul, important for historical reasons. The church owns an icon of the Virgin of the Hodegetria type, which originally lay in a Dominican church in Caffa, Crimea. The current building is a nineteenth-century reconstruction of the Fossati brothers.

properties.name: Palace of Daphne
properties.summary: The Palace of Daphne was one of the major wings of the Great Palace of Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire. According to George Codinus, it was named after a statue of the nymph Daphne, brought from Rome.

properties.name: Kefeli Mosque
properties.summary: The Kefeli Mosque is a former Eastern Orthodox church, later jointly officiated by Roman Catholics and Armenians, and finally converted into a mosque by the Ottomans. The Catholic Church was dedicated to Saint Nicholas.

properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Fatih, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Karagümrük is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Fatih, Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.summary: The Museum of the Ancient Orient is a museum in Istanbul, Turkey, and part of the Istanbul Archaeology Museums complex, located opposite the main Archaeology Museum building.

properties.name: İstinye
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: İstinye is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul, Turkey. It is on the European side of the city between the neighbourhoods of Emirgan and Yeniköy, on the northwestern shore of the Bosporus strait.

properties.name: Kabataş
properties.blurb: quarter of Beyoğlu municipality (belediye) in Istanbul, Turkey
properties.summary: Kabataş is a busy waterside area of Beyoğlu municipality on the European shore of the Bosphorus between Karaköy and Beşiktaş in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Göztepe
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Göztepe is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Kadıköy, Istanbul Province, Turkey. The name, literally meaning "eye hill" in English, was coined to honor Gözcü Baba, the nickname of the watchman of a dervish lodge situated on a hill there.

properties.name: Abdi İpekçi Street
properties.summary: Abdi İpekçi Street or Abdi İpekçi Avenue is one of the premier shopping streets of Istanbul, Turkey, located in the Şişli district.

properties.name: Sulukule
properties.summary: Sulukule is a historic quarter in the Fatih district of Istanbul, Turkey. It is within the area of Istanbul’s historic peninsula, adjacent to the western part of the city walls. The area has historically been occupied by Romani communities.

properties.name: Kumköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Kilyos, also Kumköy, is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is also a well-known seaside resort on the Black Sea coast of the European side of Istanbul Province, famous for its beaches.

properties.name: Bebek Mosque
properties.summary: Bebek Mosque, officially Hümayûn-u Âbad Mosque is a 1913-built mosque located in Bebek neighborhood of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Kara Ahmed Pasha Mosque
properties.summary: The Kara Ahmed Pasha Mosque or Gazi Ahmed Pasha Mosque is a 16th-century Ottoman mosque near the city walls in Istanbul, Turkey. It was designed by the imperial architect Mimar Sinan and completed in around 1572.

properties.name: Tomb of Hayreddin Barbarossa
properties.summary: The tomb of Hayreddin Barbarossa is the final resting place of Ottoman admiral of the fleet Hayreddin Barbarossa whose naval victories secured Ottoman dominance over the Mediterranean during the mid 16th century.

properties.name: Forum of Arcadius
properties.summary: The Forum of Arcadius, was built by the Emperor Arcadius in the city of Constantinople, now Istanbul.

properties.name: Küçük Mecidi Mosque
properties.summary: The Küçük Mecidiye Mosque is an Ottoman mosque in the Beşiktaş district of Istanbul, Turkey. It was built from the order of Sultan Abdülmecid I by Nigoğos Balyan, member of the Balyan family. The mosque is located on the Çırağan Street near the entrance to the Yıldız Park.

properties.name: Bostancı
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Bostancı is a neighborhood in the municipality and district of Kadıköy, Istanbul Province, Turkey, on the shore of the Sea of Marmara. As the easternmost neighborhood of the Kadıköy district; it borders Suadiye and Kozyatağı to the west, İçerenköy to the north, and Altıntepe to the east.

properties.name: Hodegon Monastery
properties.summary: The Hodegon Monastery in Constantinople was allegedly founded by Saint Pulcheria, a daughter of Emperor Arcadius. The monastery is considered one of the three main Marian foundations built in the city along with the Blachernai and the Chalkoprateia.

properties.name: Nusretiye Clock Tower
properties.summary: Nusretiye Clock Tower, aka Tophane Clock Tower, is a clock tower situated at Tophane, a neighborhood in Beyoğlu district of Istanbul, Turkey, next to Nusretiye Mosque and Tophane Kiosk at the European waterfront of Bosphorus.

properties.name: Rumeli Feneri
properties.summary: Rumeli Feneri, also Türkeli Feneri, a historical lighthouse still in use, is located on the European side of the Bosporus Strait's Black Sea entrance in Istanbul.

properties.name: Ayvansaray
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Fatih, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Ayvansaray is a picturesque neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Fatih, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the Golden Horn, between Balat and Eyüpsultan. It lies inside what was the walled city on Constantinople and later of İstanbul and corresponds to the old quarter of Blachernae.

properties.name: Palace of Antiochos
properties.summary: The Palace of Antiochos was an early 5th-century palace in the Byzantine capital, Constantinople. It has been identified with a palatial structure excavated in the 1940s and 1950s close to the Hippodrome of Constantinople, some of whose remains are still visible today.

properties.name: Fenerbahçe Lighthouse
properties.summary: The Fenerbahçe Lighthouse, a historical lighthouse still in use, is located on the northern coast of Sea of Marmara at Fenerbahçe neighborhood of Kadıköy district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Vahdettin Pavilion
properties.summary: Vahdettin Pavilion, a.k.a. Çengelköy Pavilion is the name of a rebuilt structure in Çengelköy neighborhood of Üsküdar district in Istanbul, Turkey. It is also the name of a historical timber mansion which stood at the same location.

properties.name: Rumelifeneri
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Rumelifeneri is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.name: Crimea Memorial Church

photos.file: Crimea Memorial Church (Kırım Kilisesi) Beyoğlu, İstanbul - Mart 2013.JPG
photos.author: VikiPicture

properties.summary: The Crimea Memorial Church, officially known as Christ Church, Galata, is a Church of England church in the Beyoglu - Taksim district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Aynalıkavak Palace
properties.summary: Aynalıkavak Pavilion is a former Ottoman pavilion located in the Hasköy neighborhood of Beyoğlu district in Istanbul, Turkey. It was constructed during the reign of Sultan Ahmed I, with various additions and changes over time. It is under the administration of the Turkish Directorate of National Palaces.

properties.name: Ayazma Mosque
properties.summary: The Ayazma Mosque is a mosque in the neighbourhood of Üsküdar in Istanbul, Turkey. It stands on a hillside overlooking the Bosphorus. It was commissioned by Ottoman Sultan Mustafa III and built between 1757 and 1761.

properties.name: Yıldız Clock Tower

photos.file: Istanbul asv2021-10 img13 Yıldız Clock Tower.jpg
photos.author: A.Savin

properties.summary: Yıldız Clock Tower, is a clock tower situated next to the courtyard of the Yıldız Hamidiye Mosque, in Yıldız neighborhood of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul, Turkey at the European side of Bosphorus.

properties.name: Hirka-i Serif Mosque
properties.summary: Hırka-i Şerif Mosque is a historic mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. It takes its name from a relic, the mantle of prophet Muhammad, which is preserved in the mosque.

properties.name: Cistern of Mocius
properties.blurb: byzantine open-sky water reservoir built in the city of Constantinople
properties.summary: The Cistern of Mocius, known in Turkish as Altımermer Çukurbostanı, was the largest Byzantine open-sky water reservoir built in the city of Constantinople.

properties.name: Rum Mehmed Pasha Mosque
properties.summary: The Rum Mehmed Pasha Mosque is an old Ottoman mosque located in a large and densely populated district of Üsküdar, in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Garipçe
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Garipçe is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.name: Yıldız
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beşiktaş, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Yıldız is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beşiktaş, Istanbul Province, Turkey. The neighbourhood comprises some of Istanbul's well known historical locations, such as Yıldız Park and Yıldız Palace, the second-largest palace in Istanbul.

properties.name: Church of St. George of Samatya

photos.file: Church of St. George of Samatya 01.jpg
photos.author: Alessandro57

properties.summary: Saint George of Samatya or Surp Kevork is an Armenian church in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Vefa
properties.summary: Vefa is part of the district of Fatih in Istanbul, and lies inside what was once the old walled city of Constantinople. It lies roughly northwest of the eastern section of the Aqueduct of Valens, and is rich in monuments, both Byzantine and Ottoman.

properties.name: Tahtakale Hamam
properties.blurb: public baths in Fatih, İstanbul–Europe, Turkey
properties.summary: The Tahtakale Hamam is a historic Ottoman hammam in Istanbul, Turkey, close to the Rüstem Pasha Mosque in the Tahtakale neighbourhood, between the Grand Bazaar and Eminönü. Built during the reign of Sultan Mehmet II, it is one of the oldest surviving bathhouses in the city.

properties.name: Kennedy Avenue

photos.file: İstanbul, Fatih, Yenikapı, Sultan Ahmet Camii, Oct 2014.jpg
photos.author: VikiPicture

properties.summary: Kennedy Avenue is a 13-kilometre-long avenue in Istanbul, Turkey that travels southwest from Sirkeci district to Bakırköy District and most importantly to the Atatürk Airport. The avenue is named for the 35th U.S. President, John F. Kennedy.

properties.name: Maslak Pavilion
properties.blurb: Maslak Pavilion is a former imperial Ottoman pavilion located in Istanbul, Turkey. It was constructed during the reign of Sultan Abdülaziz (1861-1876).
properties.summary: Maslak Pavilion is a former imperial Ottoman pavilion located in Istanbul, Turkey. It was constructed during the reign of Sultan Abdülaziz. It is under the administration of the Turkish Directorate of National Palaces. Today it is used as a museum.

properties.name: Zeyrek
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Fatih, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Zeyrek is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Fatih, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is a picturesque but poor neighbourhood. It takes its name from the huge and prominent Zeyrek Mosque which started life as a Byzantine church and sits on a plateau, overlooking the Golden Horn.

properties.name: Galatasaray

photos.author: The original uploader was Babakgh at English Wikipedia.

properties.summary: Galatasaray is a quarter on the European side of Istanbul, the largest city of Turkey, belonging to Beyoğlu district of the province of Istanbul,.

properties.name: Mausoleum of Mahmud II
properties.summary: The Tomb of Mahmud II is a tomb built by the Ottoman Sultan Abdulmecid for his father Mahmud II in Istanbul, where other sultans and members of the Ottoman Dynasty were later buried.

properties.name: Hatice Sultan Palace
properties.summary: The Hatice Sultan Mansion, a historical yalı located on the Bosphorus in the Ortaköy neighborhood of Istanbul, Turkey, and named after its original owner Hatice Sultan, is used today as the building of a water sports club.

properties.name: Joshua's Hill
properties.summary: Joshua's Hill, a hill located on the Anatolian shore of the Bosporus in the Beykoz district of Istanbul, Turkey, is a shrine consisting of a mosque and a tomb dedicated to Yusha.

properties.name: Galatasaray Museum
properties.blurb: museum in Beyoğlu, İstanbul, European Turkey
properties.summary: Galatasaray Museum is a cultural center in Istanbul, Turkey, founded in 1868 to inform the society of the traditions and history of Galatasaray.

properties.name: Atatürk Museum
properties.summary: Atatürk Museum is a historic house museum dedicated to the life of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the first president of the Republic of Turkey. It is located in the district of Şişli, on the European side of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Cistern of Aspar
properties.summary: The Cistern of Aspar or Great Cistern, known in Turkish as Sultan Selim Çukurbostanı, was a Byzantine open-air water reservoir in the city of Constantinople.

properties.name: Topkapı
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Fatih, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Topkapı is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Fatih, Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.name: Kandilli
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Üsküdar, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Kandilli is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Üsküdar, Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.name: Harbiye
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Şişli, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Harbiye is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Şişli, Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.name: Caferağa Medresseh
properties.summary: The Caferağa Medrese or Cafer Ağa Madrasa is a former medrese, located in Istanbul, Turkey, next to the Hagia Sophia. It was built in 1559 by Mimar Sinan on the orders of Cafer Agha, during the reign of Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent.

properties.name: Museum Gazhane
properties.summary: Hasanpaşa Gasworks, today known as Museum Gasworks, was a gasworks to produce coal gas in Istanbul, Turkey. Built in 1892, it was redeveloped into an arts, cultural center and technology museum in 2021.

properties.name: Piyale Pasha Mosque

photos.file: Istanbul Piyale Pasha Mosque exterior NW side in 2014 6766.jpg
photos.author: Dosseman

properties.summary: The Piyale Pasha Mosque, also known as the Tersane Mosque, is a 16th-century Ottoman mosque located in the Kasımpaşa neighborhood of the Beyoğlu district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Yeraltı Camii
properties.summary: The Yeraltı Mosque is a mosque located in the Karaköy part of the Beyoğlu district in Istanbul, Turkey. The mosque's name is derived from the fact that its prayer hall and main features of it are all underground.

properties.name: Zekeriyaköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Zekeriyaköy is an area of Sarıyer district in the European side of Istanbul. It is an upscale area in the hills to the north of downtown Istanbul. It is near the Black Sea coast and the Belgrad Forest.

properties.name: Edirnekapı Martyr's Cemetery
properties.summary: The Edirnekapı Martyr's Cemetery, one of the largest burial grounds of Istanbul, Turkey, is located in the neighborhood of Edirnekapı of Eyüp district, in the European part of the city. It consists of an old, historical part and a modern one.

properties.name: Kozyatağı
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey

photos.author: The original uploader was Mirada at Turkish Wikipedia.

properties.summary: Kozyatağı is a neighborhood in the municipality and district of Kadıköy, Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.name: Selim Üsküdar Mosque
properties.summary: The Selimiye Mosque is a mosque in the district of Üsküdar in Istanbul, Turkey, near the Selimiye Barracks. It was commissioned by Ottoman Sultan Selim III and built between 1801 and 1805.

properties.name: Aşiyan Museum
properties.blurb: museum in Beşiktaş, İstanbul, European Turkey
properties.summary: Aşiyan Museum is the house of famous Turkish poet Tevfik Fikret in the Aşiyan quarter of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul. It was built in 1906 and later in 1945 converted to a museum. The museum is owned by the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality.

properties.name: İstanbul Toy Museum
properties.summary: The Istanbul Toy Museum is a toy museum located in the Göztepe neighbourhood of Kadıköy district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Karaite Synagogue
properties.summary: The Karaite Synagogue is a Karaite Jewish congregation and kenesa or synagogue, located on Dere Street, in Hasköy, in the Beyoğlu district of Istanbul, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey. Completed in 1842, the synagogue is open, yet only open for the Karaite Passover services, or by arrangement.

properties.name: Baltalimanı
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Baltalimanı is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It lies at a bay on the European coast of the Bosporus.

properties.name: Çukurcuma
properties.summary: Çukurcuma is a district of Beyoğlu, made up of the Kuloğlu and Firuzağa neighbourhoods. It lies south-east of İstiklal Caddesi in a valley, not far from Galatasaray Square and between the Tomtom and Cihangir neighbourhoods. The main thoroughfare is Çukurcuma Caddesi.

properties.name: Büyük Valide Han
properties.summary: The Büyük Valide Han is the largest historic han in Istanbul, Turkey. It was founded in 1651 by Kösem Valide Sultan, mother of the Ottoman sultans Murat IV and Ibrahim and wife of sultan Ahmed I.

properties.name: Murat Pasha Mosque
properties.summary: The Murat Pasha Mosque is a 15th century Ottoman mosque squeezed in between two busy roads linking Aksaray and Yusufpaşa in the Fatih district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Burmalı Mosque
properties.summary: The Burmalı Mosque is a 16th-century Ottoman mosque in Saraçhane park, Fatih district, Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Cağaloğlu Hamam
properties.summary: The Cağaloğlu Hamam is a historic hamam in Sultanahmet, in the heart of the historic centre of Istanbul, Turkey. Finished in 1741, it was one of the last major hamams to be built in Constantinople/Istanbul during the Ottoman period.

properties.name: Tomb of Turhan Hatice Sultan
properties.blurb: mausoleum of five Ottoman Sultans, located at Fatih, İstanbul, Turkey
properties.summary: The Tomb of Turhan Sultan is the mausoleum of five Ottoman sultans, located at Fatih in Istanbul, Turkey. It was built in 1663 for Turhan Sultan, first Haseki of Sultan Ibrahim and mother of Sultan Mehmed IV.

properties.name: Kuruçeşme
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beşiktaş, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey

photos.file: Kuruçeşme, Kuruçeşme Cd., 34345 Beşiktaş-İstanbul, Turkey - panoramio (5).jpg
photos.author: Maksym Kozlenko

properties.summary: Kuruçeşme is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beşiktaş, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the European side of the Bosphorus between the neighbourhoods of Ortaköy and Arnavutköy.

properties.name: Ertuğrul Tekke Mosque
properties.summary: The Ertuğrul Tekke Mosque is an Ottoman imperial mosque located in Yıldız neighbourhood, Serencebey rise of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul, Turkey. A late Ottoman period mosque, it is constructed as a külliye consisting of an Ottoman takya, guest house, türbe, fountain, and library in addition to the mosque.

properties.name: Altunizade Mosque
properties.summary: Altunizade Mosque, also known as İsmail Zühtü Pasha Mosque is a 19th-century Ottoman mosque located in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Istanbul Painting and Sculpture Museum
properties.summary: The Istanbul Painting and Sculpture Museum is a museum in the Tophane area of European Istanbul, Turkey. It is part of the large Galataport complex.

properties.name: Barbaros Hayrettin Pasha Mosque

photos.file: Barbaros Hayrettin Pasha Mosque in March 2024.jpg
photos.author: Kurmanbek

properties.summary: Barbaros Hayrettin Pasha Mosque is a mosque complex in the Levent neighborhood of Istanbul, Turkey. Architect Sinan's Suleymaniye Mosque in Istanbul formed the inspiration for the design of the mosque.

properties.name: Cistern of Aetius
properties.summary: The Cistern of Aetius was an important Byzantine water reservoir in the city of Constantinople. Once one of the largest Byzantine cisterns, it is now a football stadium in Istanbul.

properties.name: Kanyon Shopping Mall

photos.author: No machine-readable author provided. Gokhan assumed (based on copyright claims).

properties.summary: Kanyon is a multi-purpose complex located on the Büyükdere Avenue in the Levent business district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Manastır Mosque
properties.summary: Manastır Mosque is a former Eastern Orthodox church converted into a mosque by the Ottomans. Neither archeological excavations nor medieval sources have made it possible to find a satisfactory answer as to its original dedication as a church.

properties.name: Ese Kapi Mosque
properties.summary: Ese Kapi Mosque, also "Isa Kapi Mosque", meaning in English "Mosque of the Gate of Jesus", is an Ottoman mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. The building was originally a Byzantine Eastern Orthodox church of unknown dedication.

properties.name: Akmerkez
properties.blurb: shopping mall located in the Etiler quarter of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul, Turkey
properties.summary: Akmerkez is a shopping mall located in the Etiler quarter of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul, Turkey. As the country's third shopping mall following Galleria Ataköy and Capitol, it was opened by a joint venture of the Akkök, Tekfen and İstikbal companies on December 18, 1993.

properties.name: Defterdar Mosque
properties.summary: The Defterdar Mosque, or the Defterdar Mahmut Efendi Mosque, is 16th century Ottoman mosque located in Eyüp, Istanbul, Turkey. It was commissioned by defterdar Nazlı Mahmut Efendi and built by architect Mimar Sinan in 1542.

properties.name: Emirgan Mosque
properties.summary: Emirgan Mosque, officially Emirgan Hamid-i Evvel Mosque is an 18th-century Ottoman mosque located in the Emirgan neighborhood of the Sarıyer district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Sokollu Mehmed Pasha II Mosque
properties.summary: The Sokollu Mehmed Pasha Mosque is a 16th-century Ottoman mosque located in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Emirgan
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Emirgan is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is a leafy, middle-class suburb of Istanbul, on the western shore of the Bosphorus north of the Fatih Sultan Mehmet Bridge.

properties.name: Toklu Dede Mosque
properties.summary: Toklu Dede Mosque, was an Ottoman mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. The building was originally a Byzantine Eastern Orthodox church of unknown dedication. It was almost completely destroyed in 1929.

properties.name: Istanbul Railway Museum
properties.summary: The Istanbul Railway Museum is a railway museum in the historic Istanbul Sirkeci Terminal in the Sirkeci neighborhood of Fatih district in Istanbul, Turkey. Opened on September 23, 2005, the museum is owned and operated by the Turkish State Railways.

properties.name: Köprülü Library
properties.summary: Köprülü Library is a library in Istanbul. It was founded by Ottoman Grand Vizier Köprülü Mehmed Pasha in 1678. It was the first public library in the Middle East. The library currently contains 3,790 manuscript volumes.

properties.name: Sadberk Hanım Museum
properties.summary: The Sadberk Hanım Museum is a private museum on the shores of the Bosphorus in the Büyükdere neighbourhood of Sarıyer district in Istanbul, Turkey. It was established by the Vehbi Koç Foundation in memory of Vehbi Koç’s deceased wife Sadberk. The museum is open every day except Wednesdays.

properties.name: Italian Synagogue
properties.summary: The Italian Synagogue, also known as Kal de los Frankos, is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on Şair Ziya Paşa Street, north of the Golden Horn, in Beyoğlu, Istanbul, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey.

properties.name: Adam Mickiewicz Museum
properties.blurb: museum in Beyoğlu, İstanbul, European Turkey
properties.summary: Adam Mickiewicz Museum is a historic house museum dedicated to the life of Adam Mickiewicz, renowned Polish poet. It is located in the district of Beyoğlu, on the European side of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Ahırkapı Feneri

photos.file: Faro de Ahırkapı, Estambul, Turquía, 2024-09-30, DD 97-99 HDR.jpg
photos.author: Diego Delso

properties.summary: The Ahırkapı Feneri, a historical lighthouse still in use, is located at the southern Seraglio Point on the Rumelian coast of Bosporus' south entrance, in Ahırkapı neighborhood of Istanbul's Fatih district, Turkey.

properties.name: Çemberlitaş
properties.summary: Çemberlitaş is a quarter in the Fatih district of Istanbul on the European side of the city. It takes its name from the Çemberlitaş Column, also known as the Column of Constantine, which stands beside the Çemberlitaş stop on the T1 tram line.

properties.name: Zincirlikuyu
properties.summary: Zincirlikuyu is a quarter of the Şişli district on the European side of Istanbul, Turkey. Part of Esentepe neighborhood, it is situated on a hilltop on the district border to Beşiktaş in the east. Having undergone redevelopment in recent years, the area is also a busy bus hub.

properties.name: Çinili Mosque
properties.summary: The Çinili Mosque is a 17th-century Ottoman mosque in the Üsküdar district of Istanbul, Turkey. The small mosque is best known for its extensive tile decoration, which earned it its name.

properties.name: Mahmut Pasha Mosque

photos.file: Istanbul asv2021-11 img37 Mahmut Pasha Mosque.jpg
photos.author: A.Savin

properties.summary: The Mahmut Pasha Mosque is a 15th-century Ottoman mosque near the Grand Bazaar in the Fatih district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Column of Leo
properties.blurb: Roman triumphal column in Constantinople (Istanbul, Turkey)
properties.summary: The Column of Leo was a 5th-century AD Roman honorific column in Constantinople. Built for Leo I, Augustus of the East from 7 February 457 to 18 January 474, the column stood in the Forum of Leo, known also as the Pittakia.

properties.name: Rumelikavağı
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Rumelikavağı, also known as Rumeli Kavağı, is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. The ferry pier which is the center of the neighborhood is at 41°10′54″N 29°04′30″E.

properties.name: Teşvikiye
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Şişli, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Teşvikiye is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Şişli, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is one of the four neighbourhoods within the Nişantaşı quarter.

properties.name: Cağaloğlu
properties.blurb: neighborhood in Istanbul, renown for publishing houses
properties.summary: Cağaloğlu is a quarter located in the Fatih district of Istanbul, Turkey. Much of the publishing industry in Istanbul is located in Cağaloğlu. It is also famous for its ancient hamam, known as the Cağaloğlu Hamam.

properties.name: Paşabahçe
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beykoz, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Paşabahçe is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beykoz, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is located on the Anatolian side of the Bosphorus.

properties.name: Beylerbeyi Mosque
properties.summary: The Beylerbeyi Mosque, also known as the Hamid i-Evvel Mosque, is a mosque located in the Beylerbeyi neighbourhood in Istanbul, Turkey. It was first built in 1777–1778 by the Ottoman sultan Abdul Hamid I, but was later modified by Mahmud II in 1820–1821.

properties.name: Şişli Armenian Cemetery
properties.summary: The Şişli Armenian Cemetery is an Armenian cemetery in the Şişli district of Istanbul, Turkey, which is operated and served by the Armenian community of Turkey.

properties.name: Suadiye
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Suadiye is a neighborhood in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul, Turkey with a population of 26,428. It is known for its European-esque restaurants and cafes and location near the coast and luxurious lifestyle, in relation with the rest of the Bağdat Avenue area.

properties.name: Maçka Park
properties.summary: Maçka Democracy Park is a recreational area in Istanbul, Turkey, which has paths for jogging, walking and dog walking. It also has children's areas, rest areas and benches and decorative pools.

properties.name: Bulgur Palace
properties.summary: The Bulgur Palas, originally known as the Bolulu Habip Bey Mansion, is a historical mansion located in Istanbul, Turkey. It was restored and redeveloped into a library and cultural center for public use after its acquisition by the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality in 2021.

properties.name: Çarşamba
properties.summary: Çarşamba is a small part of the Fatih district of Istanbul, Turkey, close to the Fatih Mosque. It is one of the most conservative areas of the city.

properties.name: Poyrazköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beykoz, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Poyrazköy is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beykoz, Istanbul Province, Turkey. Poyraz lies at the exit of the Bosporus into the Black Sea, on the Asian side of the Strait.

properties.name: Şeyh Süleyman Mosque
properties.summary: Şeyh Süleyman Mosque is a mosque in Istanbul converted from a former Byzantine building which was part of the Eastern Orthodox Pantokrator Monastery. Its usage during the Byzantine era is unclear. The small building is a minor example of architecture of the Byzantine middle period in Constantinople.

properties.name: Amastrianum
properties.summary: The Amastrianum, also called Forum Amastrianum by modern authors, was a public square in the city of Constantinople. Used also as place for public mutilations and executions, it disappeared completely after the end of the Byzantine Empire.

properties.name: Suleymaniye Library (Istanbul)
properties.summary: This is a list of libraries within the city limits of Istanbul.

properties.name: Soğukçeşme Sokağı
properties.summary: Soğukçeşme Sokağı is a small street with historic houses in the Sultanahmet neighborhood of Istanbul, Turkey, sandwiched in-between the Hagia Sophia and Topkapı Palace. The car-free zone street is named after the fountain situated at its end towards Gülhane Park.

properties.name: Hemdat Israel Synagogue

photos.file: Istanbul asv2021-11 img01 Hemdat Israel Synagogue.jpg
photos.author: A.Savin

properties.summary: The Hemdat Israel Synagogue is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on Izzettin Street, in the Yeldeğirmeni neighbourhood of the Jewish quarter of Haydarpaşa in Kadıköy, on the Asian side of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Church of Saint Menas of Samatya
properties.summary: Saint Menas is a Greek Orthodox Church in Istanbul.

properties.name: Rüstem Pasha Medrese
properties.summary: Rüstem Pasha Medrese is a former medrese, located in Fatih district of Istanbul, Turkey. It was commissioned by Ottoman statesman and grand vizier Rüstem Pasha, and built by court architect Mimar Sinan in 1551.

properties.name: Edirnekapı
properties.summary: Edirnekapı is a quarter of Istanbul, Turkey. It is part of the district of Fatih and belongs to the walled city.

properties.name: Bet Israel Synagogue
properties.summary: The Bet Israel Synagogue, also known as the Beit Israel Synagogue, is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on Efe Street, in Şişli, Istanbul, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey.

Vişne translates to "sour cherry" from Turkish and the neighborhood is named after İzzeti Mehmet Efendi, an Ottoman statesman nicknamed Vişnezade who was known to cultivate sour cherry in the place of this neighborhood.

properties.name: Yalıköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beykoz, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Yalıköy is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beykoz, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It lies by the Anatolian/Asian side of the Bosphorus Strait. The name is a combination of two words: yalı and köy.

properties.name: Feneryolu
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Feneryolu is a neighbourhood in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul, Turkey. It covers an area of approximately 1.0 km². Located just inland from the Marmara Sea, Feneryolu is situated between the coastal neighbourhood of Fenerbahçe and the residential area of Fikirtepe.

properties.name: Kırmızı Beyoğlu Mosque
properties.summary: The Kırmızı Minare Mosque is a mosque in the Hasköy neighborhood of Beyoğlu, Istanbul, Turkey. It was probably built in 1591 by Kiremitçi Ahmet Agha and so is also known as the Kiremitçi Ahmet Agha Mosque. It received the name "Red Minaret" because of its red brick minaret.

properties.name: Rasimpaşa
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Rasimpaşa is a neighborhood in the district of Kadıköy, Istanbul, Turkey. Rasimpaşa is an important historical neighborhood, much of which is registered as an Urban and Historical Protected Area. The neighborhood also includes the Haydarpaşa Train Station and Haydarpaşa Port.

properties.name: Uskumruköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Uskumruköy is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is situated to the north of Belgrad Forest which is one of the most popular excursion areas of Istanbul citizens.

properties.name: MetroCity AVM
properties.summary: MetroCity AVM, opened on April 30, 2003, is a modern shopping mall on the Büyükdere Avenue in the finance and business quarter of 1. Levent in Istanbul, Turkey, with a direct connection to the Levent subway station.

properties.name: Merkez
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beykoz, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Merkez or Beykoz Merkez is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Beykoz, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is the city center of Beykoz district and one of its 45 neighborhoods on the Anatolian/Asian side of Istanbul.

properties.name: Abdi İpekçi Peace Monument
properties.summary: The Abdi İpekçi Peace Monument is a monument sculpted by Gürdal Duyar, commissioned by the Şişli Municipality in 2000 in honor of the editor-in-chief of the Milliyet newspaper Abdi İpekçi and erected at the place where he was assassinated in Istanbul, Turkey, in 1979.

properties.name: St. Ignatius Greek Orthodox Cemetery, Kadıköy
properties.summary: Kadıköy Greek Orthodox Cemetery, also known as Hasanpaşa Uzunçayır Orthodox Cemetery, is a Christian cemetery in Istanbul, Turkey. The burial ground is the final resting place of people professing the Orthodox faith in Istanbul.

properties.name: Pearl Kiosk
properties.summary: The Pearl Kiosk was a mansion directly located at the banks of the Bosphorus and served as a pleasure building for the Ottoman sultan. It was built in 1590 by the grand vizier Koca Sinan Pasha.

properties.name: Ayakapı
properties.summary: Ayakapı is a quarter of Istanbul, Turkey. It is part of the district of Fatih, inside the walled city, and lies on the shore of the Golden Horn.

properties.name: Mayor Synagogue, Istanbul
properties.summary: The Mayor Synagogue, also known as the Majorka Synagogue, is a former Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on Hasköy Avenue, in the Hasköy district of Beyoğlu, Istanbul, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey. Completed in the 19th century, the building was used as a synagogue until 1923.

properties.name: Merdivenköy
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Merdivenköy is a neighborhood in the Kadıköy district, Istanbul. Its northern border is the D.100 highway, with the Üsküdar and Ataşehir districts on the other side.

properties.name: Malta Kiosk
properties.blurb: historic imperial Ottoman residence in Istanbul, Turkey
properties.summary: The Malta Kiosk, also known as the Malta Pavilion, is a historic imperial Ottoman residence located within the garden of the Yıldız Palace in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Kuruçeşme Arena
properties.summary: Paraf Kuruçeşme Open Air or formerly known as Turkcell Kuruçeşme Arena was an open-air music venue located at Kuruçeşme neighborhood of Beşiktaş district in Istanbul, Turkey. It was also used as an outdoor cinema.

properties.name: Türkiye İş Bankası Museum
properties.blurb: museum in Fatih, İstanbul, European Turkey
properties.summary: İşbank Museum is a bank museum in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Hacımimi
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beyoğlu, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Hacımimi is a neighborhood in the Beyoğlu District of Istanbul, Turkey. The neighborhood is located on a slope descending toward the Bosporus, with streets arranged more or less in a grid. The neighborhood contains many historic structures.

properties.name: Sahrayıcedit
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Sahrayicedit is a neighborhood in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul, Turkey. It is bordered to the northeast by the D.100 highway and the adjacent Ataşehir district, to the south by the 19 Mayıs neighborhood of Kadıköy, and to the west by the Erenköy and Merdivenköy neighborhoods.

properties.name: Arif Sarıca Mansion
properties.summary: Arif Sarıca Mansion is an Ottoman-era mansion in Istanbul, Turkey. It was built in 1903.

properties.name: İcadiye
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Üsküdar, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: İcadiye is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Üsküdar, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the Asian side of Istanbul.

properties.name: Aşiyan
properties.summary: Aşiyan is a quarter located between Bebek and Rumelihisarı in the Beşiktaş district of Istanbul, Turkey. It is situated on the European side of the Bosphorus. Aşiyan Museum and Aşiyan Asri Cemetery are located in the quarter.

properties.name: Kanlıca Cemetery
properties.summary: The Kanlıca Cemetery is a burial ground located on the Asian part of Istanbul, Turkey. It is administered by the Metropolitan Municipality. Many prominent figures from the world of media and music rest here.

properties.name: Burhaniye
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Üsküdar, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Burhaniye is a neighborhood in the municipality and district of Üsküdar, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the Asian side of Istanbul. Burhaniye is mostly a residential neighborhood, with few historic houses and buildings.

properties.name: Nişancı Mehmed Pasha Mosque
properties.summary: The Nışançı Mehmed Pasha Mosque is a late 16th-century Ottoman mosque in Istanbul, Turkey. The mosque is part of an architectural complex that also includes the tomb of its founder, Nışançı Mehmed Pasha, and formerly included two madrasas and a Sufi lodge.

properties.name: Zeyrek Çinili Hamam
properties.blurb: hamam-muse complex in Fatih district, Istanbul
properties.summary: Zeyrek Çinili Hamam is a hamam-museum complex located in Istanbul's historic Zeyrek district.

properties.name: Barbaros Monument
properties.blurb: monument in Beşiktaş, İstanbul, European Turkey
properties.summary: Monument in Beşiktaş, İstanbul, European Turkey.

properties.name: Suriye Pasajı
properties.summary: Suriye Pasajı is a historical six-storey shopping arcade located in Istanbul, Turkey, in the Asmalımescit subdistrict of Beyoğlu. The arcade is situated on İstiklal Avenue 166. The ground floor of the arcade hosts a wide array of businesses, meanwhile upper floors are being mostly used for residential accommodation.

properties.name: Doğançay Museum
properties.blurb: museum in Beyoğlu, İstanbul, European Turkey
properties.summary: The Doğançay Museum, Turkey’s first modern art museum, is dedicated to the artistic legacy of Burhan Doğançay.

properties.name: Çamlıca
properties.summary: Çamlıca is a leafy district of Üsküdar on the Asian side of Istanbul. It is famous for two hills—Big Çamlıca and Little Çamlıca —offering panoramic views across the Sea of Marmara and the Princes' Islands to the European side of Istanbul and Sarayburnu.

properties.name: Maalem Synagogue
properties.summary: The Maalem Synagogue is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on Harap Çeşme Street, on the slopes overlooking the Golden Horn, near the Jewish old age home in the Hasköy district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Kadıköy İnciburnu Feneri
properties.summary: The Kadıköy İnciburnu Feneri is a lighthouse located at the head of Kadıköy Harbor's İnciburnu Breakwater on the Anatolian coast of Bosporus' south entrance, in Kadıköy district of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Piyer Loti Museum
properties.summary: Piyer Loti Museum is a museum in Istanbul, Turkey. Piyer Loti refers to Pierre Loti, the French novelist who spent a part of his life in Istanbul.

properties.name: Avrupa Pasajı
properties.blurb: shopping mall in İstanbul Beyoğlu, Turkey
properties.summary: Avrupa Pasajı or Passage d'Europe is a historical shopping arcade that connects Meşrutiyet Caddesi and Sahne Sokak in İstanbul's Beyoğlu district. The building is located in Hüseyinağa subdistrict and is close to Galatasaray High School and Beyoğlu Fish Market. It is also called Aynalı Pasaj.

properties.name: Göztepe railway station
properties.summary: Göztepe station is a historical railway station in Kadıköy, Istanbul. Between 1969 and 2013, it was a station on the Haydarpaşa suburban railway line to Gebze. A modern station of the same name is now a stop on the Marmaray commuter rail service to Gebze.

properties.name: Hasanpaşa
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Hasanpaşa is a mahalle in the district of Kadıköy on the Anatolian side of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: 19 Mayıs
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: 19 Mayıs is a neighborhood in the district of Kadıköy, Istanbul, Turkey. It is a fast developing neighborhood, full of large apartment blocks.

properties.name: Orhan Kemal Literature Museum
properties.blurb: museum in Beyoğlu, İstanbul, European Turkey
properties.summary: The Orhan Kemal Literature Museum is a literary museum and archive in Istanbul, Turkey dedicated to Turkish literature, and named after novelist Orhan Kemal.

properties.name: Tepe Nautilus
properties.summary: Tepe Nautilus, opened in September 2001, is a shopping mall in Turkey. Built by Tepe Group, it is situated in the Acıbadem quarter of Kadıköy district in the Asian part of Istanbul.

properties.name: Harbiye Muhsin Ertuğrul Stage
properties.summary: Harbiye Muhsin Ertuğrul Stage is a theatre venue in the Harbiye neighborhood of Şişli district in Istanbul, Turkey. It is owned by Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality and operated by its City Theatres division. The theatre is named in honor of the Turkish stage actor and director Muhsin Ertuğrul.

properties.name: Fatih Sultan Mehmet
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Fatih Sultan Mehmet is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It lies next to the TEM highway.

properties.name: Rami Library
properties.summary: Rami Library is a public library established in 2023 housed in the redeveloped 18th-century Rami Barracks in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.summary: The Galib Pasha Mosque is a mosque situated on the Bağdat Street in the Caddebostan, neighbourhood and the Erenköy quarter in Kadıköy, Istanbul. It was constructed in 1899 by Abdullah Galib Pasha in the Abdulhamid II period, as written on its entrance.

properties.name: Osmanağa
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Osmanağa is a neighborhood in the district of Kadıköy, Istanbul, Turkey. Osmanağa is one of the central neighborhoods of Kadıköy, located at the intersection of important land and sea transportation networks.

properties.name: Fındıkzade
properties.summary: Fındıkzade is a quarter in the European side of Istanbul, located in the north side of Fatih, the province's capital district, lying between the quarters of Topkapı and Aksaray, and adjacent to the Hasseki, Yusufpaşa and Çapa quarters.

properties.name: Istanbul City Theatres
properties.summary: Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality City Theatre The theater was founded in 1914 in the Ottoman Empire period as Dârülbedayi.It was a theater company connected to the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality budget in the name of IMM City Theaters in 1934.

properties.name: Agios Panteleimonas Greek Orthodox Church, Kuzguncuk

properties.summary: Agios Panteleimonas Greek Orthodox Church is a Greek Orthodox church dedicated to Saint Pantaleon located in Kuzguncuk neighborhood of Üsküdar district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Rumelihisarı
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Sarıyer, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Rumelihisarı is a neighbourhood in the municipality and district of Sarıyer, Istanbul Province, Turkey. It is on the European side of Istanbul. The neighbourhood is famous for and named after its medieval fortress, Rumelihisarı, built by Mehmed the Conqueror between 1451 and 1452.

properties.name: Caddebostan Synagogue
properties.summary: The Caddebostan Synagogue is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located at 3 Taş Mektep Street, in Göztepe, in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey.

properties.name: Atikali
properties.summary: Atikali is a neighbourhood on the European side of Istanbul, Turkey, in the municipality and district of Fatih.

properties.name: Surp Bogos Church
properties.summary: Surp Bogos Church, is an Armenian Catholic church in Büyükdere, Sarıyer, northern Istanbul, Turkey. It was established as a wooden church in 1847, rebuilt in masonry in 1882, and consecrated in 1885.

properties.name: Feneryolu railway station
properties.summary: Feneryolu railway station is a station on the Marmaray commuter rail line in Kadıköy, Istanbul. It replaced the 145 year old railway station, built by the Ottoman Anatolian Railway.

properties.name: Bet Avraam Synagogue
properties.summary: The Bet Avraam Synagogue, also known as the Hesed Beit Avraham Synagogue, is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located behind the main train station, in Sirkeci, Istanbul, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey.

properties.name: Hacı Beşir Ağa Mosque
properties.summary: The Haji Beshir Agha Mosque, located in Istanbul's Fatih district, was built in 1745. The design of the Haji Beşir Agha Mosque can be described as baroque.

properties.name: Ara Güler Museum
properties.summary: Ara Güler Museum is a photography museum in Istanbul, Turkey, exhibiting photographs taken by the photojournalist Ara Güler. Established in 2018, the museum also houses an archive of his work.

properties.name: Abdulhakim Sanjak Mosque
properties.summary: Abdulhakim Sanjak Mosque, or ITU Mosque is a mosque located in Istanbul Technical University. It was established in September 7, 2019, on a total area of 11,500 square meters. For use of the mosque, it is required to be an ITU student, academician or personal.

properties.name: Kandilli Earthquake Museum
properties.summary: Kandilli Earthquake Museum, or more formally Museum of Kandilli Observatory and Earthquake Research Institut, is a museum devoted mainly to seismology and earthquake science in Turkey. It is situated within the campus of Kandilli Observatory in Kandilli neighborhood of Üsküdar district in Istanbul.

properties.name: Women's Library and Information Centre Foundation
properties.name_tr: Kadın Eserleri Kütüphanesi ve Bilgi Merkezi Vakfı
properties.blurb: library for female writers in Turkey
properties.summary: The Women's Library and Information Centre Foundation is the first and only women's library in Turkey. It was founded in Istanbul in 1989 and opened on April 14, 1990, mainly to assist research on the history of women.

properties.name: Karadolap
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Eyüpsultan, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Karadolap is a neighborhood in the district of Eyüpsultan, Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.summary: The Monastery of Stoudios, more fully Monastery of Saint John the Forerunner "at Stoudios", often shortened to Stoudios, Studion or Stoudion, was a Greek Orthodox monastery in Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire. The residents of the monastery were referred to as Stoudites or Studites.

properties.name: Hidayet Mosque

properties.name: Bet Nissim Synagogue
properties.summary: The Bet Nissim Synagogue, also known as the Beit Nisim Synagogue, is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located on Yakup Street, in Kuzguncuk, Üsküdar, Istanbul, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey.

properties.name: Erenköy railway station
properties.summary: Erenköy station is a railway station in Kadıköy, Istanbul. Between 1969 and 2013, it was a station on the Haydarpaşa suburban to Gebze and starting on 10 March 2019, a station on the Marmaray commuter rail system.

properties.name: Eğitim
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Kadıköy, İstanbul–Asia, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Eğitim is a neighborhood in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul, Turkey. It is located on the Anatolian side of Istanbul.

properties.name: Şehzadebaşı
properties.summary: Şehzadebaşı is a quarter of the Fatih district in the European part of Istanbul. Although its exact boundaries cannot be drawn as it is a quarter, administratively it covers part of the mahalle of Kemalpaşa and Kalenderhane.

properties.name: TGC Press Media Museum
properties.blurb: media museum, technology museum in Istanbul, Turkey
properties.summary: The TGC Press Media Museum, aka Istanbul Press Media Museum, is a history and technology museum dedicated to mass communication in Turkey featuring exhibitions about journalism. It is located in the Çemberlitaş neighborhood of Fatih district in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Zühtüpaşa

properties.summary: Zühtüpaşa is a neighborhood in the district of Kadıköy, Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Büyükdere Surp Hripsimyants Church
properties.summary: Büyükdere Surp Hripsimyants Church, also known as Saint Hripsimians Church,,, is an Armenian Apostolic church located in Büyükdere, Sarıyer in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Türkmenbaşı Nature Park

properties.summary: Türkmenbaşı Nature Park is a nature park located in Sarıyer district of Istanbul Province, Turkey.

properties.name: Haydarpaşa Breakwater
properties.summary: Abdul Hamid II Monument or Haydarpaşa Breakwater, is a monument located on the breakwater opposite Istanbul Haydarpaşa railway station. The monument was built by the architect Alexander Vallaury in honor of the 25th anniversary of Abdul Hamid II's accession to the throne.

properties.name: Kulaksız
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Beyoğlu, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Kulaksız is a neighborhood in the Beyoğlu District of Istanbul, Turkey. Much of the neighborhood's land is taken up by the large Kulaksız and Zindan Arkası Cemeteries and the smaller Eminefendi Cemetery.

The Surp Agop Armenian Hospital is also on the same avenue.

properties.summary: Altımermer is a quarter located in the European part of Istanbul, Turkey. It is located in the western part of the district of Fatih. Although it is difficult to define exactly its boundary, Altımermer lies between the neighborhoods of Kocamustafapaşa and Seyyid Ömer.

properties.summary: Bereketzade Ali Efendi Mosque is a mosque in Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Göztepe 60. Yıl Park
properties.summary: Göztepe 60. Year Park, commonly referred to as just Göztepe Park, is a park located in the Caddebostan neighborhood and the Göztepe quarter in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul. To the north is Bağdat Avenue and to the south is Operatör Cemil Topuzlu Avenue.

properties.name: Yusuf Şucaeddin Camii Çeşmesi
properties.summary: Yusuf Şucaeddin Mosque Fountain or Balat Fountain is an Ottoman period fountain in the Ayvansaray neighborhood of Istanbul's Fatih district. After the Golden Horn coastal road works in the 1980s, it remained in the garden of Yusuf Şucaeddin Mosque.

properties.name: Böcekli Mosque
properties.summary: The Böcekli Mosque or Tüccarbaşı Böcekli Mosque is a mosque in the Tüccarbaşı area of Sahrayıcedit, Kadıköy, Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.name: Yavuz Sultan Selim Madras
properties.summary: The Yavuz Sultan Selim Medrese in Istanbul was built by Mimar Sinan in memory of Selim the first from 1548 till 1550. The medrese is also known as "Yenibahce Selim Medrese".

properties.name: Gedikpaşa Tiyatrosu
properties.summary: The Gedikpaşa Tiyatrosu, also known as the Ottoman Theater and Vartovian Theatre, was an Ottoman theatre established in Istanbul in 1866 and active until 1884.

properties.name: Çırçır
properties.blurb: mahalle (administrative quarter) in Eyüpsultan, İstanbul–Europe, northwestern Turkey
properties.summary: Çırçır is a neighborhood in the Eyüpsultan District of Istanbul, Turkey. It is bordered on the north by the 5. Levent neighborhood, on the east by the Alibeyköy neighborhood, on the south by the Karadolap neighborhood, and on the west by the Akşemsettin neighborhood.

properties.name: Fil Bridge
properties.summary: The Fil Bridge, also known as Silahtarağa Bridge is a 38 m long, concrete bowstring bridge that crosses the Alibeyköy Creek in Istanbul, Turkey. The bridge was completed in 1932 by the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality.

properties.name: Mihrimah Üsküdar Mosque
properties.summary: The Mihrimah Sultan Mosque is a 16th century Ottoman mosque overlooking the waterfront in the historic center of the Üsküdar district of Istanbul, Turkey. One of Üsküdar's best-known landmarks, it takes its alternative name from the ferry terminal near which it stands.

properties.name: Miniatürk
properties.summary: Miniatürk is a miniature park at the northeastern shore of Golden Horn in Istanbul, Turkey. It was opened on 2 May 2003. It is one of the world's largest miniature parks, with a 15,000 m2 model area and total area of 60,000 square metres.

properties.summary: Yıldıztabya is a neighborhood in the Gaziosmanpaşa District of Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.summary: Çiftehavuzlar is an informal neighbourhood in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul, Turkey. It is roughly located west of Göztepe 60. Year Park and east of Selamiçeşme, between the neighbourhoods of Caddebostan and Feneryolu on the Bağdat Avenue.

properties.name: Dumlupınar

properties.summary: Dumlupınar is a neighborhood in the district of Kadıköy, on the Anatolian side of Istanbul, Turkey. Vertical architecture is increasing as the neighborhood undergoes urban transformation.

properties.summary: Çorbacı Fountain is a fountain in Balat, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey.

properties.summary: The Molla Çelebi Mosque, sometimes known as the Fındıklı Mosque is a 16th-century Ottoman mosque located in the Fındıklı neighbourhood of the Beyoğlu district of Istanbul, Turkey. It was commissioned by Kazasker Mehmet Vusuli Efendi, chief judge of Istanbul and designed by the imperial architect Mimar Sinan.

properties.name: Ahrida Synagogue of Istanbul
properties.summary: The Ahrida Synagogue, or Ohrid Synagogue, is a Jewish congregation and synagogue, located in Ayvansaray Mahallesi, in Balat, a once-thriving Jewish quarter of the city, in Fatih, in the Istanbul Province of Turkey. Completed in c. 1430, it is the oldest of all 26 synagogues in the city.

properties.name: Monument of Liberty, Istanbul
properties.summary: The Monument of Liberty, in the Şişli-Mecidiyeköy district of Istanbul, Turkey, is a memorial in honour of the soldiers killed defending the Ottoman Parliament against rebel forces during the 31 March Incident.
